title: Contact us
metaDescription: For project enquiries, tenders and vendor verification, contact Sato Engineering & Infrastructure Limited.

body: For project enquiries, tenders and vendor verification, contact our head office.

sections.heading: Send an enquiry
sections.successHeading: Thank you — your enquiry has been sent.
sections.successBody: A member of our team will reply from our head office, normally within two working days. If your enquiry concerns a tender deadline, please also call the number above so we can respond faster.
sections.mailtoBody: We have not received anything yet — your enquiry is a draft in your own mail application. Check the details and press send there, and our head office will reply, normally within two working days.
sections.unavailableMessage: The enquiry form is not accepting submissions yet. Please call the number above, or email our head office directly.
sections.errorMessage: Your enquiry could not be sent. Please try again, or email us directly using the address above.
sections.fallbackNote: This will open a new message in your email application with the details you entered.
